notes.env: Every value becomes a string; nested keys are joined with __.
notes.properties: Every value becomes a string; nested keys are joined with dots, array items as [0].

errors.undetected: Could not tell which format this is. Pick it under From.
errors.toml-null: TOML has no null, and “{{path}}” is null. Give it a value or remove it.
errors.not-a-table: {{format}} holds only keys at the top, but this config is an array or a single value.
errors.bad-key: A .env key holds only letters, digits, _, . and -, so “{{key}}” cannot be written.
